blocked.name: The Quinault Big Cedar
blocked.reason: DEAD. Was the largest tree in the world outside the California redwoods/sequoias (174ft tall, 62ft 8in circumference, ~15,300 cubic feet), on a trail two miles up Lake Quinault's North Shore Road. Fell/collapsed the weekend of 8 July 2016, likely from root damage caused by visitor trampling around its base, per The Daily World's own report. A roughly 20-foot stump now marks the spot. Never deliver as a collectible entry; this confirms the task brief's caution about its 2014 partial collapse -- it did not survive.
